content:
Apple TV subscribers can now watch all episodes of the new season of the award-winning mindfulness-themed animated series "Stillwater." Check out the trailer below.

All five episodes are now available

The trailer for the new season of "Stillwater" was released just days ago, and Apple TV has today made all five episodes of the Emmy Award-winning, Zen-inspired series available for streaming.

"Stillwater" is based on Jon J Muth's best-selling "Zen" picture book series published by Scholastic. The original series premiered in 2020 and has since won the Daytime Emmy Award for "Outstanding Editing for a Pre-School Animated Program" as well as a Peabody Award in the children's and youth programming category.

Season 4 of "Stillwater" premiered last August, ending a two-year hiatus since Season 3. If you haven't watched the series yet, here's how Apple TV describes it:
